mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORTS WHERE DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORTS (DEFECT_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, DEFECT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (REPORTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{orderItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{defectType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE REPORTS SET DEFECT_TYPE = #{defectType}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE DEFECT_ID = #{defectId}
